reason.title: Why being online is no longer optional?
reason.subtitle: Digital is no longer the future, it's the present. Companies that invest in a solid online presence strengthen their brand, reach more people and grow predictably.
reason.card1Text: Your company visible to people from anywhere, with no geographic limits.
reason.card2Text: Your business active 24 hours a day, informing and selling automatically.
reason.card3Text: Build credibility and trust with a professional and well-structured website.
reason.card4Text: Serve more clients simultaneously without increasing your fixed costs.

process.title: Our creation process
process.step1Text: We understand your business, target audience and goals to define the best digital strategy and ideal solution type.
process.step2Text: We create modern and intuitive interfaces, focused on user experience (UX) and usability, with visual prototypes before development.
process.step3Text: We transform the project into secure, scalable and high-performance code, using modern technologies in web and system development.
process.step4Text: We perform complete testing, launch the solution and monitor results to ensure stability, performance and continuous evolution.

projects.rafahelena: We developed architect Rafaela Helena's website with a focus on conveying sophistication, personality and creativity. The platform showcases the portfolio, presents services elegantly and offers a fluid experience.
projects.rafahelenaShort: Website designed to showcase the portfolio and convey sophistication. Fluid navigation, clean visuals and focus on project presentation.
projects.sdl: We created a modern and functional institutional website for SDL Consultoria, highlighting its advisory services in occupational safety, environment and training.
projects.sdlShort: Modern institutional website to present services and facilitate contact. Clear structure, well-organized content and straightforward navigation.
projects.lovegoods: We built the Lovegoods online store, specialized in creative gifts and collectibles. The website highlights products with a dynamic layout focused on user experience.
projects.lovegoodsShort: E-commerce focused on user experience and conversion. Dynamic layout to highlight products and make purchasing easy.
projects.cloock: We developed a complete system for companies that work with online scheduling. The platform allows intuitive control of schedules, services, blocks and reservations.
projects.cloockShort: We developed a complete system for companies that work with online scheduling. The platform allows intuitive control of schedules, services, blocks and reservations.
projects.guilherme: We created a custom website to highlight the work of photographer and videographer Guilherme Schulze. The platform presents his projects and portfolio with a modern visual experience.
projects.guilhermeShort: We created a custom website to highlight the work of photographer and videographer Guilherme Schulze. The platform presents his projects and portfolio with a modern visual experience.
projects.auros: We delivered a tailor-made digital solution for the real estate sector, with an internal system for property management and a modern, responsive website optimized for searches.
projects.aurosShort: We delivered a tailor-made digital solution for the real estate sector, with an internal system for property management and a modern, responsive website optimized for searches.
projects.fidliz: We created a digital loyalty platform that replaces physical cards. Now, customers accumulate points directly on their phone, without depending on anything other than the device itself.
projects.minhareserva: We developed an internal system for classroom booking, making it easier for teachers to schedule sessions, with control over schedules and available equipment.
projects.minhaprova: We created a personalized exam application system, focused on agility and automation. The system allows assessments to be built quickly and calculates grades in real time.
projects.apjesc: We developed the APJESC institutional website along with an internal system for managing courses, members and administrative content, bringing more organization, autonomy and efficiency to the entity.
projects.magaventures: We developed an internal system for tracking the performance of startups in the Magaventures ecosystem, with strategic dashboards, revenue control, growth metrics and centralized vision for decision-making.
projects.patrono: We developed the institutional website for Patrono Assessoria e Consultoria Júnior, the first law junior enterprise at UESC. The platform presents legal services with a sophisticated look, reinforcing credibility and making it easy to contact the team.
projects.patronoShort: Institutional website for the first law junior enterprise at UESC. Sophisticated look, focused on credibility and easy contact with the team.
projects.tbmotors: We built the website for TB Motors, a premium pre-owned vehicle dealership. The platform showcases the full inventory of cars and motorcycles with detailed listings, search filters and direct WhatsApp contact.
projects.tbmotorsShort: Website for a premium pre-owned vehicle dealership, featuring a vehicle showcase, search filters and direct WhatsApp contact.

testimonials.t1Content: My architecture website turned out excellent! Exactly the way I wanted it, highly recommend!!
testimonials.t2Content: I had my professional website built with Code Labz and it turned out excellent! The design is very beautiful, modern and the navigation is super fluid. I was very satisfied with the result and highly recommend it!
testimonials.t3Content: Hiring Code Labz was essential. They developed a complete solution for us: a modern website for clients and a robust system for our property management. I strongly recommend them for quality and competence.
testimonials.t4Content: Code Labz did an excellent job on our Landing Page. The website turned out professional, objective and perfectly conveyed the seriousness of our consulting firm. I recommend them for their speed and quality.
testimonials.t5Content: Excellent work from Code Labz. They developed a complete portal and an internal system that greatly facilitated the administration and control of our members. I recommend!
